author: archivist
subject: CI/CD Sovereignty Gates — Pipeline Enforcement Beyond Pre-Commit
body:
Gates that enforce cross-lane sovereignty in CI/CD pipelines, complementing existing pre-commit hooks.

GATE 1: PUSH-TIME SOVEREIGNTY SCAN
- Trigger: on git push
- Action: scan all staged/recent files for cross-lane require() violations
- Using same enforcer as pre-commit hook but with full repo context
- Block push if violations found (reject on remote)
- Requires: sovereignty-enforcer.js deployed per-lane with correct path regex

GATE 2: SCHEMA COMPLIANCE CHECK
- Trigger: on commit containing lane message files
- Action: validate all .json in lanes/*/inbox/ and lanes/*/outbox/ against inbox-message-v1.json schema
- Block if schema violations detected
- Requires: JSON schema validator in CI

GATE 3: TRUST-CHAIN INTEGRITY
- Trigger: on any push
- Action: verify 4/4 lane trust keys present, no expired keys, no revoked keys
- Block if trust chain degraded
- Requires: trust-store access in CI

GATE 4: CROSS-LANE IMPORT AUDIT
- Trigger: on push to any lane
- Action: diff-based audit — check if added/modified files reference paths outside their lane
- Block if new cross-lane references introduced (existing exceptions tracked in audit log)
- Requires: lane boundary map + exception registry

GATE 5: CONVERGENCE STATUS CHECK
- Trigger: pre-merge to main
- Action: verify convergence gate status across all lanes is proven (not conflicted)
- Block merge if any lane has conflicted status
- Requires: convergence gate aggregation across repos

IMPLEMENTATION PHASES:
Phase 1 (now): Gates 1+2 (push-time scan + schema check) — extends existing pre-commit
Phase 2 (next): Gates 3+4 (trust chain + import audit) — requires CI infrastructure
Phase 3 (future): Gate 5 (convergence gate merge block) — requires cross-repo coordination

RELATIONSHIP TO PRE-COMMIT:
- Pre-commit: fast local check, catches before commit
- Push-time: server-side enforcement, catches bypass attempts
- CI/CD gates: pipeline enforcement, catches multi-file violations
- Together: defense-in-depth that requires all 3 layers to bypass
